pages.note: No Supreme Court judgment pronounced in this window was reported by the legal publications we track. Rulings reported on 20 October (e.g. Tejaram v. State of Rajasthan, Dr M.K. Ravi Varma v. NIT) were decided earlier and are left out.

pages.title: Orders
pages.note: No Supreme Court interim order, stay or notice passed in this window was reported by the legal publications we track.

items.caseName: X (Rape Victim) v. State of U.P. & Ors.
items.coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, Amitabh Kumar Rai, JJ.
items.headline: No injury in medical report is no ground to deny compensation
items.text: POCSO survivor's claim under the Mahila Samman Kosh scheme was wrongly rejected; ₹3 lakh to be paid within 10 days.

items.headline: Notice to MoRTH over sleeper bus safety after Jewar fire
items.text: In a suo motu case on the bus fire that killed nine, the Transport Ministry was asked to respond on AIS-119/135 compliance; listed 17 Nov.

items.caseName: Kusumlata v. State of U.P. & Ors.
items.headline: Documents of all UP basic school teachers to be verified
items.text: Statewide check of teachers' qualifications and appointment papers ordered, with affidavits disclosing relatives in senior education posts.

items.caseName: Ashok Bahar v. Union of India & Ors.
items.headline: No court-ordered senior citizens' quota in NEET
items.text: Appeal dismissed: a 1% quota for senior citizens in medical admissions is a policy call for the government, not a writ court.

items.coram: Ravindra Vithalrao Ghuge, CJ, Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.
items.headline: Retired judge may head Durga Puja stampede probe
items.text: PIL on the Chorbagan stampede (19 dead) kept pending; if no sitting judge is spared, State may appoint a retired HC judge.

items.caseName: Surajit Mondal v. State of West Bengal & Ors.
items.coram: Ravindra Vithalrao Ghuge, CJ, Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.
items.headline: State must reply to PIL on stamp papers for TMC rebels
items.text: State to file affidavit by 20 Nov on claims police used fraudulent stamp papers; maintainability to be decided first. Listed 11 Dec.

items.caseName: Milan Pradhan v. State of West Bengal
items.headline: Interim bail extended in 2007 Nandigram case
items.text: Interim bail extended to late November on the same conditions; he must surrender before the ACJM, Haldia on 27 Nov.

items.caseName: Shyam Veer v. State of H.P.
items.headline: Penetration to any extent suffices under POCSO
items.text: Absence of injuries doesn't defeat a penetrative assault charge; conviction for aggravated assault on a child under 12 upheld.

items.caseName: Brij Lal & Ors. v. UT of J&K & Ors.
items.headline: Preventive proceedings don't trigger double jeopardy
items.text: Ss. 107/117 CrPC proceedings are preventive, not punitive, so Article 20 doesn't bar the trespass and assault charge sheet.

items.caseName: Union of India v. Babu Ram
items.headline: Disability not noted at enrolment presumed service-related
items.text: AFT's disability pension award upheld; Medical Board gave no reasons, and pension can't be denied just for disability under 20%.

items.caseName: Nadeem Ur Rehman v. State of Karnataka & Anr.
items.headline: Father who gave car keys to minor son must face homicide trial
items.text: Refusing to quash the S.304 Part II IPC charge, the court said knowingly handing a car to a 14-year-old can show the required knowledge.
